cause: The test hook closes its started notification channel on every between-query callback. Basic Git status capture may retry once after errGitStatusEvidenceChanged, and observations in separate admission classes can also overlap. The hook is therefore allowed to run more than once; closing the same channel again panics. Existing TestWorkspaceTrackerGitStatusCaptureRecoveryRetriesOneEvidenceChange asserts two callback invocations on the valid retry path.
planned_fix: Change only this test fixture: use a capacity-one started signal and a nonblocking send, while keeping each hook invocation blocked on the existing release channel. Preserve cancellation, publication, cached-status, and file assertions.
scope: test fixture only; no production, CI, timeout, retry, skip, or assertion changes
